title: Approval Authority Matrix
content: For requests below 5,000 USD: department manager approval. From 5,000 through 24,999 USD: department director plus Procurement review. At 25,000 USD or above: department VP, Procurement Director, and Finance Controller review. Any restricted software or open security exception also requires Security Officer review. Approval authority is based on gross request value; currency conversion is not supported in this demo. The named person must hold the applicable approver role.
